original_query_receipts.sql: SELECT p.problem_id,p.title,p.source_id,p.source_locator_json,s.author,s.work,length(p.tex_content) AS retained_chars FROM problems p JOIN sources s ON p.source_id=s.source_id WHERE lower(p.title) LIKE '%stationary%time%' OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%strong%stationar%' OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%stationary%dual%' OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%separation%distance%' OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%perfect%sampl%' ORDER BY p.problem_id LIMIT 60

SELECT p.problem_id,p.title,p.source_id,s.author,s.work,length(p.tex_content) AS retained_chars FROM problems p JOIN sources s ON p.source_id=s.source_id WHERE lower(p.title) LIKE '%markov%' OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%mixing%time%' OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%stopping%time%' OR (lower(p.title) LIKE '%coupling%' AND lower(p.title) LIKE '%sampl%') ORDER BY p.problem_id LIMIT 80
